system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Agent 模式暴露的是按场景收窄后的工具集：建书、读写控制面、规划、编排、写作、审稿、修订、短篇、封面、Play 等能力会按当前 session 类型开放。
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt packs are editable per project (prompt/<pack>/<prompt>.md) and skills inject instructions; inferred from README prose, no source line opened.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: 故事记忆、材料库和 Skill 参考资料共用 SQLite FTS5 / BM25 检索投影；原始文件仍是权威来源，索引可重建，检索结果保留来源与位置。
env_context_strategy.note: BM25 retrieval plus Composer task-based context selection and agent tool access to files.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: 故事状态、Markdown 投影、SQLite 记忆、会话摘要和 protected / compressible 语义压缩共同工作，降低旧历史淹没当前指令的问题。
context_compaction.note: Session summaries = summarize; protected/compressible semantic compression of context.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Chat 可读取文本、Markdown 和图片
observation_format.note: Text tool results plus generated/attached images (covers, node images).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Studio Chat、TUI、`inkos interact` 与生产 worker 共用 pi-agent 工具循环和结构化 action/result
tool_call_format.note: pi-agent tool loop with structured action/result; exact call syntax not shown in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: 可通过聊天修改章节、封面提示词、世界状态和持久化文本产物
edit_primitive.note: Local chapter edits and file writes mentioned; primitive not explicitly specified in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: InkOS 直接使用标准 `SKILL.md` 作为专业能力扩展，不再维护一套 InkOS 私有 Skill 协议。
tool_schema_source.note: Skills are hand-written Markdown; tool schema source itself not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: InkOS 已发布为 [OpenClaw](https://clawhub.ai/narcooo/inkos) Skill，可被任何兼容 Agent（Claude Code、OpenClaw 等）直接调用
protocol_standardization.evidence_locator: README.md 通过 OpenClaw 使用 (tag:v1.8.0 52075bb)
protocol_standardization.note: Standard SKILL.md / OpenClaw skill interoperability; no MCP mentioned in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Studio Chat、TUI、`inkos interact` 与生产 worker 共用 pi-agent 工具循环和结构化 action/result；既有 pipeline 降为可直接调用、可中断、可观测的确定性能力
loop_primitives.note: The default loop is the pi-agent tool loop (react). Pipelines run write → audit → revise; the README says '按“写作 → 审稿 → 必要修订 → 状态结算”推进' (generate_test_repair/fixed_pipeline). Plot-branch exploration generates 2-5 isolated branches for comparison (multi_attempt).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: | **写手 Writer** | 基于编排后的精简上下文生成正文（字数治理 + 对话引导） |
multi_agent_topology.note: Specialised agents (Radar, Planner, Composer, Architect, Writer, Observer, Reflector, Normalizer, Auditor, Reviser) hand off in a fixed sequence.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: | **连续性审计员 Auditor** | 对照结构化状态、控制文档和章节上下文验证草稿，执行连续性与质量检查 |
delegation_mechanism.note: Control passes between specialised agent roles in the chapter pipeline.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: 普通聊天、建书、短篇、封面、互动世界都走同一套 action surface。重动作先确认，生成物可预览
human_in_loop.note: Heavy actions require user confirmation first. Unresolved audit issues are flagged for human review ('其他问题标记给人工审核'), which may also count as on_completion.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: | `story/state/*.json` | 权威结构化状态：当前状态、伏笔、章节摘要等，经过 Zod schema 校验 |

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Node 22+ 自动启用的 SQLite 时序记忆库，用于相关事实、伏笔和摘要检索
long_term_memory.note: story/*.md projections = file_notes; memory.db = episodic_db; SKILL.md packs = skill_library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: 刷新或重启后可恢复正确进度、终态与完整工具卡片。

self_verification.evidence_quote: 连续性审计员从 37 个维度检查每一章草稿：角色记忆、物资连续性、伏笔回收、大纲偏离、叙事节奏、情感弧线等。
self_verification.note: Auditor agent is a separate LLM role judging the draft; post-write validator applies hard rules.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: 默认长篇写作链路最多自动修订一次；如果你更看重自动闭环，可以通过 `writing.reviewRetries` 调整修订轮数。

rollback.evidence_quote: 每章自动创建状态快照，`inkos write rewrite` 可回滚任意章节。

termination_condition.evidence_quote: 首 Token / 流式空闲超时、过期状态修复和原子文件集降低被动卡住或半完成的概率。
termination_condition.note: Completion determined by real tool results/files; idle/stream timeouts end stuck runs. No step or cost cap found in evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: 给不同 Agent 分配不同模型，按需平衡质量与成本
cost_controls.evidence_locator: README.md 方式三：多模型路由 (tag:v1.8.0 52075bb)
cost_controls.note: Token usage is reported via analytics but no budget cap found in evidence.

timeouts.evidence_quote: 首 Token / 流式空闲超时
timeouts.note: Per model-call streaming timeouts; no run-level wall clock limit in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: 可被外部 AI Agent 通过 `exec` 调用，也可用于脚本编排。
execution_isolation.note: Local Node CLI/Studio running on host; no container isolation mentioned.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: 外部 Skill 只提供指令和静态参考资料，InkOS 不会自动执行其中的脚本；它也不会绕过现有工具权限与确认闸门。
filesystem_access.note: Writes go to the project workspace (books, shorts/, covers/, story/) via InkOS tools; path-safety tests exist.

network_policy.evidence_quote: 新增 `research_web`，用于世界观、职业、年代、市场和事实核查
network_policy.note: Web research and arbitrary provider endpoints; no egress restriction mentioned.

permission_model.evidence_quote: 模型负责理解、提议和调用能力；InkOS 负责确认、上下文、状态、原子落盘和产物真实性。
permission_model.note: Heavy actions are confirmed first ('重动作先确认'). It is unclear whether every call or only heavy actions need confirmation.

tracing.evidence_locator: README.md 守护进程 + 通知推送 (tag:v1.8.0 52075bb)
tracing.note: Also per-chapter trace.json compile traces; no OpenTelemetry in evidence.

replayability.evidence_quote: `inkos write rewrite [id] <n>` | 重写第 N 章（恢复状态快照，`--force` 跳过确认，`--words` 覆盖字数）
replayability.note: Session transcripts can be restored and chapters re-run from snapshots; no replay of recorded model outputs stated.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `inkos eval [id]` | 生成质量评估报告（支持 `--json`、章节范围）
eval_hooks.note: Quality evaluation/analytics ship in-repo; not a standard external benchmark.

guardrails.evidence_quote: LLM 输出的 JSON delta 在写入前经过 `applyRuntimeStateDelta` 做 immutable 更新 + `validateRuntimeState` 结构校验。坏数据直接拒绝，不会滚雪球。
guardrails.note: Validation rejects bad output before write; confirmation gates and sensitive-words/AI-tells filtering act on outputs.

target_domain.evidence_quote: InkOS 是一个面向故事创作与多语言翻译的 AI Agent 系统
target_domain.note: Domain is creative writing / story production and translation; no listed value fits.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: 支持任何 OpenAI 兼容接口（Studio 里新增自定义服务，或 CLI 使用 `--provider custom` / `INKOS_LLM_PROVIDER=custom`）
